propositions: Extract build_model_settings() and build_usage_limits() from runner.py into structured_run.py as pure functions with explicit parameters, with cache_settings as a required input parameter.

build_usage_limits() must return tuple(UsageLimits, req_limit, eff_max_iter) to enable independent access to both counters at runner.py:542-543 and runner.py:572-573, since eff_max_iter is unrecoverable from the stored max(8, eff_max_iter) value.

build_model_settings() must perform no side effects; the _TEMPERATURE_WITHDRAWN_LOGGED.add() mutation must remain inline in run() to maintain the leaf invariant and pass test_structured_run_has_no_runtime_import_from_runner.

Temperature withdrawal must be controlled by caps.supports_temperature: withdrawn when False, retained when True, with the dedup-logging block remaining in runner.py to avoid mutatating a module-global from a leaf module.
Per-request output cap and step budget can only raise the configured floor, never lower it; the return contract must document which counters are independent and which are derived.

After extraction, runner.py must be under 700 LOC, structured_run.py must remain under 500 LOC with the extracted code adding no net bloat, and both hardcoded symbol lists in test_structured_run_seam.py must be updated to cover the new functions.
